essence: Offering into that kindled fire enables the performer to obtain a virtuous son.
Performing ten thousand oblations makes the practitioner victorious in all circumstances.
Meditating on Indra's position quickly brings an unobstructed kingdom.
Repeating the mantra ten thousand times beginning with the target's name certainly subdues that person.
Reciting the mantra in this way for seven days frees one from diseases.
